title: mnemo: a zero-dependency memory layer for AI agents (value-ranked recall + corroboration-gated influence)
description: mnemo is the recall + consolidation core of an autonomous research system, distilled to a single dependency-free Python file plus an MCP server. It provides value-ranked retrieval (relevance x accrued value), per-type decay, capacity-aware consolidation, contradiction flagging, a lexical+semantic auto-mode (BM25 + embeddings fused by Reciprocal Rank Fusion), and — new in 0.4.0 — corroboration-gated INFLUENCE: recall(influence_only=True) restricts the memories allowed to drive an action to those that earned corroboration (a credited good outcome, or >=2 distinct-source links), which we measured drops an AgentPoison-style single-instance retrieval-poisoning attack's rank-1 hijack to 0% across three dense retrievers and every corpus scale (60->10k), because it lives in provenance metadata rather than embedding geometry. Design rules are measured, not assumed (provenance in the README + runnable probes).
